setup_message:
Welcome to the initial setup of Spotify for ReDeck
Go to https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard for creating an app.
Also don't forget to set a callback_url !
For more facility, set http://localhost:8000
Next, define credentials with the query /spotify/set_credentials... Read /docs for more information...
set_credentials_desc: Permet de re-définir les credentials de Spotify via des requêtes GET !
get_credentials_desc: Permet de vérifier la valeur des credentials spotify via réponse GET !
pause_desc: Ordonne la mise en pause de la lecture active !
resume_desc: Ordonne la mise en lecture de lecture active !
